samples.summary: Text-box clear-formatting test never verifies its own precondition (that select-all produced a selection), so it can pass vacuously
samples.evidence: The test does `api.insertLink(...)`, then `selectAll()` (a synthetic Mod+A keydown), then `api.applyStyle({bold, color})`, then `api.clearInlineFormatting()`. Both writes go through `applyStyleImpl`, which returns immediately when there is no selection (packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:820 `if (!selection.hasSelection() || !selection.range) return;`). If the synthetic keydown ever stops producing a selection (different key handling, focus not on the textarea, layout not ready), bold/color are never applied and `clearInlineFormatting` is a no-op — yet every assertion still holds: the text is still the URL, an inline still carries the href, and `bold`/`color` are falsy because they were never set. The regression the test claims to guard (href being stripped by clear formatting) would then go undetected. Asserting bold/color are actually set before clearing (or that a selection exists) would make it non-vacuous.
searchedFor: grep for select-all handling in text-box-editor.ts and text-editor.ts (case 'a')

samples.summary: The collapsed-caret (pending style) branch of `clearFormatting` changed key set but has no test
samples.evidence: `clearFormatting` now pends `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` at a collapsed caret instead of its old hand-rolled list — materially different: it now also clears fontSize/fontFamily/color/backgroundColor and no longer clears `href`, so typing right after Cmd+\ inside a link now inherits the hyperlink where it previously did not. Both new/changed test files only exercise range selections (`selectWholeBlock`, `selectAll`). The only caret-path assertion I found is `packages/docs/test/view/text-box-editor.test.ts:43-45`, which merely asserts `clearInlineFormatting` does not throw with no selection — it asserts nothing about the pending key set or about typing afterwards.
searchedFor: read editor-clear-formatting.test.ts and text-box-clear-formatting.test.ts in full

samples.summary: 'removeLink is still how a hyperlink is dropped' would also pass under the very regression it sits next to
samples.evidence: The test clears formatting, moves the caret, calls `removeLink`, and asserts no inline has an `href`. If `href` were (re)added to `CLEAR_INLINE_STYLE` — the #1051 bug — the earlier `clearInlineFormatting()` alone would satisfy the final assertion, so this test cannot distinguish 'removeLink works' from 'clear formatting deleted the link'. It does still catch a fully broken `removeLink` today, and the sibling test covers the href-survives case, so the gap is presentational: asserting the href is present immediately before `removeLink()` would tighten it.

samples.summary: Shortcut/button parity assertion is narrower than the drift it documents
samples.evidence: The Mod+\ test comments that the old hand-rolled list 'omitted the font and colour keys' but only asserts `bold` and `color` are falsy. `fontSize`, `fontFamily` and `backgroundColor` — three of the four keys that had drifted — are not asserted on the shortcut path, and the fixture doesn't set them, so a partial regression in the shared key set on that path would not be caught here.
searchedFor: read the Mod+\ test body and linkedBlock fixture
